nodes.name: Greater Will
nodes.base_description: An Outer God, described as a cosmic parasite. Its influence is represented by golden light ('grace'). It desires unity of power and enacts its will through vassals like Marika. Confers immortality.

states.current_description: Active ruler using Marika as vassal to enforce Golden Order and unity.
Angry and fading influence after Shattering; imprisoned Marika/Radagon in Erdtree to maintain control; views returning Tarnished as opportunity to repair Ring.

nodes.name: Queen Marika
nodes.base_description: Vassal of the Greater Will, bearer of the Elden Ring, Queen of the Lands Between. Descended from the Numen race. Split half of Radagon.

states.current_description: Active Queen and Vassal of Greater Will. Established Leyndell, waged wars against Giants/Dragons/Carians. Married Godfrey then Radagon. Bore children Godwyn, Mogh, Morgott, Malenia, Miquella. Entrusted Rune of Death to Maliketh.
Imprisoned within the Erdtree by the Greater Will as punishment for shattering the Elden Ring in grief/defiance after Godwyn's death. Her true desire is for the Elden Beast to be slain.

nodes.name: Radagon
nodes.base_description: Second consort of Marika. Formerly married to Rennala. Part of Marika ('Radagon is Marika'). Adherent to the Greater Will.

states.current_description: General for Marika, then Consort to Rennala of Caria. Had red hair due to curse from Last Fire Giant. Father of Radahn, Rykard, Ranni.
Left Rennala to marry Marika, becoming second consort and adherent to Greater Will. Father of Malenia and Miquella. Attempted to repair Elden Ring after Shattering.
Imprisoned within the Erdtree alongside Marika after the Shattering.

nodes.name: Elden Beast
nodes.base_description: Vassal of the Greater Will sent within a star. Physical manifestation of the Greater Will's power.

states.current_description: Absorbed into Marika's body. Source of power for the Elden Ring and Erdtree. Target of Marika's secret desire to be slain.

nodes.name: Two Fingers
nodes.base_description: Literal emissaries of the Greater Will that try to enact its desires. They choose Empyreans.

states.current_description: Active emissaries guiding Tarnished and choosing Empyreans. Bent with age but still functioning.

nodes.name: Golden Order
nodes.base_description: A human system of beliefs established to help enact the Greater Will’s desires. Views omens as curses. Discriminates against 'impure' beings.

states.current_description: Dominant belief system enforcing unity and discriminating against Omens, Demi-humans, etc. Supported by Marika and Radagon.
Shattered and contested following the Shattering War. Believed in by Morgott and Goldmask despite flaws.

nodes.name: Dragons
nodes.base_description: Race that first ruled the Lands Between, led by Dragonlord Placidusax. Allied with an unnamed Outer God which later abandoned them.

states.current_description: Rulers of Lands Between. Allied with Unnamed Outer God. Declining after abandonment.
Mostly pacified after war with Leyndell. Some join cults or become Magma Wyrms.

nodes.name: Dragonlord Placidusax
nodes.base_description: Leader of the dragons during the age when they ruled the Lands Between.

states.current_description: Active leader of Dragons in Farum Azula.
Absent/Waiting in temporal vortex after decline of Dragons.

nodes.name: Unnamed Outer God
nodes.base_description: Outer God allied with the Dragons. Abandoned them over time, leading to their decline.

states.current_description: Allied with Dragons.
Abandoned Dragons, causing their decline.

nodes.name: Farum Azula
nodes.base_description: Sky city of the dragons.

states.current_description: Intact sky city of Dragons.
Crumbled and subsumed in temporal vortex.

nodes.name: Erdtree
nodes.base_description: Central tree in the Lands Between, source of power for the Golden Order. Previously existed in a 'primordial' form known as the Crucible.

states.current_description: Primordial form known as the Crucible.
Current version of Erdtree. Source of Golden Order power. Contains imprisoned Marika and Radagon.

nodes.name: Crucible
nodes.base_description: Primordial form of the Erdtree, understood as the crucible of life.

states.current_description: Active primordial form of life. Signs (horns/tails) seen as blessings.
Transformed into current Erdtree. Signs now viewed as curses.

nodes.name: Godwyn
nodes.base_description: Son of Marika and Godfrey, known as Godwyn the Golden.

states.current_description: Alive, beloved son of Marika. Befriended dragon Fortissax.
Dead. Corpse sprouts Deathroots in Deeproot Depths. Worshipped as Prince of Death.

nodes.name: Fortissax
nodes.base_description: Dragon befriended by Godwyn the Golden.

states.current_description: Befriended by living Godwyn.
Corrupted by Deathblight after Godwyn's death.

nodes.name: Maliketh
nodes.base_description: Marika's half-brother and Shadow. Holder of Rune of Death.

states.current_description: Trustworthy holder of Rune of Death for Marika.
Betrayed. Takes penance as Gurranq, feeding on Deathroots.

nodes.name: Gloam-Eyed Queen
nodes.base_description: Former holder of the Rune of Death. Goddess of death.

states.current_description: Alive, holder of Rune of Death. Leader of Godskin Apostles.
Slain by Maliketh.

nodes.name: Fire Giants
nodes.base_description: Race waged war against Marika. Led by Storm Lord.

states.current_description: Active threat to Erdtree. Waging war against Marika.
Defeated. Mostly eradicated. Last Giant cursed to guard Forge.

nodes.name: Last Fire Giant
nodes.base_description: Survivor of the war against Fire Giants.

states.current_description: Active warrior. Cursed Radagon with red hair.
Cursed by Marika to attend Forge of Giants for eternity.

nodes.name: Godfrey
nodes.base_description: First consort of Marika, formerly Horah Loux.

states.current_description: First Consort of Marika. General in wars against Giants/Dragons.
Banished from Lands Between. Became first Tarnished. Lost grace.

nodes.name: Rennala
nodes.base_description: Queen of Caria. Head of Academy of Raya Lucaria.

states.current_description: Queen of Caria. Married to Radagon. Mother of Radahn, Rykard, Ranni.
Devastated by Radagon's departure. Locked away. Shell of herself.

nodes.name: Ranni
nodes.base_description: Lunar Princess, daughter of Radagon and Rennala. Empyrean.

states.current_description: Alive Empyrean. Daughter of Radagon/Rennala.
Body killed intentionally. Soul resides in doll resembling Snow Witch. Escaped Greater Will's vassalage.

nodes.name: Radahn
nodes.base_description: General, son of Radagon and Rennala. Holds up the stars.

states.current_description: Active General. Holds up stars to prevent beast incursions and restrict sorcery. Claims Great Rune.
Afflicted by Scarlet Rot. Reduced to sickened shell. Comatose.

nodes.name: Malenia
nodes.base_description: Daughter of Marika and Radagon. Empyrean. Afflicted by Scarlet Rot.

states.current_description: Active Warrior. Serves Miquella. Marches to Caelid.
Comatose after blooming Scarlet Rot in battle with Radahn. Carried back to Haligtree by Finlay.

nodes.name: Miquella
nodes.base_description: Son of Marika and Radagon. Empyrean. Cursed with eternal youth.

states.current_description: Active. Created Haligtree. Rejects Golden Order.
Stolen by Mogh. Rejects Mogh's ambitions.

nodes.name: Elden Ring
nodes.base_description: Physical manifestation of Greater Will's power. Made of runes.

states.current_description: Whole. Borne by Marika. Source of immortality and order.
Shattered by Marika. Pieces (Great Runes) claimed by demigods.

nodes.name: Caelid
nodes.base_description: Region in Lands Between.

states.current_description: Normal region. Site of Sellia.
Devastated by Scarlet Rot bloom from Malenia.

nodes.name: Tarnished
nodes.base_description: Those who lost the grace of the Greater Will.

states.current_description: Banished from Lands Between. Includes Godfrey.
Returned to Lands Between after Shattering. Guided by Two Fingers to repair Ring.
